****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Do you have experience working with HR systems and master data processes, and would you like to help shape JYSK’s future HCM platform? Are you motivated to play a central role in the implementation of our new HCM solution across JYSK countries? Then this could be your next opportunity at JYSK Head office in Aarhus.

As HCM System Specialist, you will join the agile Human Capital Management team and act as a subject matter expert within HR systems and processes. You will work closely with colleagues in Payroll, HR and IT across JYSK countries, helping to optimise existing solutions while supporting the implementation of new systems and processes. The role combines system expertise, stakeholder collaboration, testing, training and continuous improvement in an international environment.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, your attitude, commitment and willingness to learn are valued. You will become part of an experienced and supportive team where knowledge sharing, collaboration and development are part of everyday work. As we continue our digital transformation journey within HR, you will have the opportunity to influence solutions used across the organisation and contribute to projects with significant business impact.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in one of the largest initiatives currently taking place in JYSK helping shape future HR processes and technology globally in JYSK

• The chance to contribute to the continued development and support of our HR systems across 30 JYSK countries impacting more than 38.000 employees in JYSK

• The opportunity to participate in and lead selected HCM projects

• Close collaboration with HR, Payroll and IT stakeholders across the business

• A workplace where responsibility and trust go hand in hand

• Professional and personal development opportunities in an international company

• An agile working environment focused on continuous improvement

• Strong teams, knowledge sharing and a supportive culture

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and improving HCM processes and systems across the organisation. You will help ensure stable operations while contributing to future system developments, process design and overall requirement management. You will act as the link between business needs and technical solutions and play a key role in ensuring quality through testing, training and stakeholder collaboration.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Subject matter expert support on and optimisation of SAP HR and HR master data processes

• Drive and take part in the implementation of global HCM templates ensuring scalable and standardised solutions across countries

• Translating business requirements into functional specifications for IT teams

• Supporting implementation activities across countries

• Participating in and leading selected HCM projects and rollouts

• Planning, coordinating and executing testing activities for new HCM solutions

• Delivering user support, training sessions and knowledge-sharing activities

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who enjoys combining system knowledge with collaboration and problem-solving. You are structured in your approach, comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and motivated by improving processes and solutions that create value across the business.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 3-5 years of experience working with HCM systems, e.g. SAP SuccessFactors or SAP HR

• Holds a bachelor's degree within HR, Organisation, Business Administration or a related field, or has equivalent experience from Payroll or HR Support

• Has experience with system implementation, process development or digital transformation initiatives

• Has worked with system testing, user support and training activities

• Communicates clearly and can translate business needs into technical requirements

• Builds strong relationships with stakeholders across functions and countries

• Thrives in an agile environment and takes responsibility for delivering high-quality results

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Sustainability & Total Rewards Director, Ditte Revsbæk Hansen at +45 3050 8125.

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Do you want to have an influence on home furnishing trends across multiple countries? As Head of Range and Design at JYSK, you will define how our products look, feel and work together – from sleep and furniture to textiles and home décor.

You will own the vision and direction for JYSK’s overall product universe, establishing the design DNA that connects our products across categories. By translating our brand, trends, customer insights and commercial ambitions into a clear design direction and compelling collections, you will make it easier for customers to create an affordable Scandinavian home.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join an international retail company with high ambitions, short decision-making processes and a strong focus on results. Based at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus, Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues across the organisation to turn creative ideas into products that reach customers across countries.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A strategic leadership role with significant influence on JYSK’s design direction, product universe and customer experience

• Leadership responsibility for a dedicated three-person team, with opportunities to develop the team

• Close involvement in product development, supplier partnerships and emerging home furnishing trends

• A cross-functional working environment where creative ideas are balanced with customer needs and commercial objectives

• A results-oriented culture built on trust, teamwork and freedom with responsibility

• A straightforward working environment where ideas can quickly become action

• Opportunities for professional and personal development, along with attractive employee benefits

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Head of Range and Design, you will own and develop JYSK’s overall design direction and collection architecture across product categories. You will ensure that our Scandinavian design DNA is reflected consistently in our collections, with colours, materials, shapes, functionality, quality and packaging working together to create a recognisable customer experience. Balancing creative ambition with customer insights and commercial priorities, you will turn the design vision into compelling, commercially successful products.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Developing collection architecture and design briefs in close collaboration with Category Management and suppliers

• Using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design decisions and strengthen range performance

• Presenting design concepts and recommendations to stakeholders, aligning creative ideas with commercial priorities

• Collaborating with Marketing, E-Commerce, Visual Merchandising and Sales & Expansion on photography, social media, campaigns and the overall customer experience

Besides the above, you will lead and develop the three-person Design team, setting clear priorities, providing constructive feedback and fostering a culture of creative excellence, collaboration and commercial awareness. You will participate in range meetings, trade fairs and supplier visits in Denmark and abroad, travelling approximately 30–40 days per year to stay up to date with emerging trends and bring new inspiration into JYSK.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a colleague who combines a strong design vision with commercial understanding and the ability to translate creative ideas into successful products across a broad product range.

Ideally, you bring:

• Solid experience in design, product development, range management or category management within an international retail, brand or lifestyle business, with a strong track record of developing product concepts or collections

• The ability to define a clear design direction and translate it into practical design briefs and priorities

• A strong understanding of Scandinavian design, including colours, materials, functionality and visual consistency

• A data-driven approach to decision-making, using customer insights, sales data and profitability to guide design choices

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships and create alignment across functions

• Experience in leading and developing colleagues, setting clear priorities and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development

• Fluency in English and confidence in presenting design concepts and recommendations to different stakeholders

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact EVP Purchasing, Martin Amstrup Bang at +45 2540 8402.

We encourage you to attach a portfolio showcasing relevant design work, collections, concepts or projects that demonstrate your design approach and experience. The portfolio can be uploaded together with your CV or shared via a link in your application.

Are you motivated by supporting agile teams, driving digital progress, and enabling high-quality deliveries in a collaborative and structured environment?

If so, this could be your next opportunity to join JYSK and be part of an international retail success story.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you will join a fast-paced and forward-thinking organisation that values growth, continuous improvement, and professional development.

You will become part of Available to Promise (ATP) and Flow of Goods Execution (FEX), two agile teams in Purchasing ART (Agile Release Train) with a clear mission: ensuring reliable product availability and efficient flow of goods from suppliers to stores and customers. Together with business specialists, developers, and stakeholders, the teams drive digital solutions and continuous improvements that strengthen supply chain processes including order fulfillment, supplier collaboration, and inventory processes, supporting seamless operations from suppliers to stores and customers.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
a supportive and collaborative culture where learning and knowledge sharing are part of daily work

• 
a workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority

• 
the opportunity to work closely with other IT Delivery Leads in the ART and through our Community of Practice

• 
an organization with short decision paths and high levels of autonomy

• 
close cooperation with stakeholders across all levels of the organization

• 
a workplace that values work-life balance and employee wellbeing

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As an IT Delivery Lead at JYSK, you drive successful delivery across iterations and ensure the team can achieve its PI (Program Increment) commitments. You create clarity and focus by strengthening agile ways of working, ensuring transparent data, and removing obstacles that block progress. With a strong delivery mindset, you coordinate dependencies across teams, foster predictable and disciplined execution, and enable fact‑based decisions. Your leadership helps secure flow, stability, and business value -building a healthy, well-functioning, and high-performing team.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• 
Drive planning and coordination to secure steady progress and strong delivery outcomes

• 
Remove obstacles and enable the team to reach its goals with confidence

• 
Lead and facilitate agile events that strengthen flow, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• 
Indirect leadership and coaching of the team in agile methods and principles to ensure high‑quality deliveries

• 
Foster change management through open communication, collaboration, and proactive handling of risks, dependencies, and issues

• 
Partner closely with Product Owners, IT Delivery Managers, Line Managers, and stakeholders across JYSK and ARTs

• 
Drive and implement IT delivery initiatives together with key stakeholders to improve ways of working

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
has 5+ years of experience in driving digital deliveries to meet objective, quality and timeline, either from a role within IT project management/Scrum Master or software development.

• 
has strong interpersonal skills and actively contributes to team motivation and engagement

• 
works in a pragmatic, structured, goal-oriented way and adapts easily to changing priorities

• 
communicates clearly and confidently with a variety of stakeholders

• 
has strong problem-solving abilities, challenges constructively and proactively removes blockers to team progress

• 
have experience with facilitating agile events and workshops effectively

• 
is experienced in agile practices, methodologies, and frameworks, such as Scrum, Kanban, and/or SAFe

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Senior Data Engineer - AI & Databricks , you will help shape how AI is adopted across Danfoss Climate Solutions, especially within our global sales organization.

Working as part of a global team of data, analytics, and AI professionals, you will build and evolve a trusted, scalable, and well-governed Databricks platform that enables sales teams across multiple regions and functions to turn data into actionable insights. Your work will support use cases such as sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights, helping teams make faster, data-driven decisions.

By ensuring the platform is secure, high-quality, and continuously improving, you will enable reliable data products and Generative AI solutions that drive business value. Working closely with data engineers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders, you will help establish best practices and scale AI adoption across the organization.

Success in this role means delivering trusted, AI-ready data products that strengthen governance, accelerate AI adoption, and support better business decisions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and improve Databricks governance, including Unity Catalog, data access, security, and data quality

• Design and maintain scalable data architecture, ensuring best practices across data models, tables, and pipelines

• Enhance Genie spaces (AI-powered knowledge tools) by improving content, entity matching, and answer quality for end users

• Partner with cross-functional teams to enable adoption of data products and AI solutions that support data-driven sales decisions

• Evaluate and implement new Databricks and AI capabilities to improve platform performance and deliver measurable business value

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse), including Unity Catalog and data governance practices

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience building scalable data models and modern ETL pipelines

• Proven ability to design and manage data platforms that enable analytics or AI use cases in a business environment

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, translating data and AI capabilities into practical business solutions

• Fluent in English, with strong communication skills and a proactive interest in applying emerging AI technologies

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape how AI is applied across global sales teams, driving measurable improvements in forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights

• Work hands-on with Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Generative AI to build solutions used across multiple markets

• Influence how data and AI solutions are scaled globally, working with diverse teams and stakeholders

• Grow in a collaborative and international environment that supports continuous learning, innovation, and career development

• A competitive compensation package and flexible hybrid working model, with access to global opportunities

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about building data platforms that power real-world AI applications and drive business decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and explore how your work can shape the future of AI at Danfoss.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Job Description

**We at Danske Bank connect global markets and help businesses grow. As Head of Guarantees, you will lead our guarantee teams across the Nordics, shaping the strategic direction of our business that sits at the heart of our Trade and Working Capital Solutions offering.

**What You Will Be Doing

**This is an opportunity to combine deep financial expertise with people leadership and digital innovation. You will join the Trade and Working Capital Solutions department, reporting to the Co-head and working within a matrix organisation that spans countries and functions. The team is collaborative and commercially minded, with a shared commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality service to clients. You will partner closely with teams across the organization and represent the guarantees business in internal forums and external industry discussions.

More specifically, you will:

• Set and execute the strategic direction for the guarantees business across the Nordics

• Lead the transformation of guarantee processes using AI, digitalisation and automation

• Develop and grow the guarantee teams, building capabilities and a clear succession pipeline

• Partner with sales and advisory teams to deliver guarantee solutions that meet client needs

• Ensure all activities comply with legal, regulatory and internal governance requirements

• Use business and service measures to identify improvements and build operational resilience

**About You

**

• Degree in finance, economics, business or a related discipline

• Comprehensive knowledge of banking and global trade

• Demonstrated experience leading and developing specialist teams

• Strong understanding of AI, digitalisation and their responsible application in banking

• Comfortable working across countries and functions in a matrix organisation

• Clear commercial judgement with sound risk management awareness

• Professional fluency in English and at least one Nordic language

Familiarity with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks across multiple Nordic markets is an advantage. Experience with succession planning and talent development would also be a welcome addition, supporting you in your transformational leadership role.

**What We Offer You

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Danske Bank’s guarantees business across the Nordics and lead its transformation. You will be offered a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, in addition to real opportunities for professional growth and development. Working alongside knowledgeable and supportive colleagues, you will spend three to four days per week in the office whilst we offer you the flexibility to work in a way that fits your life. This position can be based on our modern offices in any Nordic country.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. To apply, please send your CV and cover letter via our recruitment system by November 11th, 2026.

For questions about the role, please reach out to hiring manager Jukka Kuusala at jukka.kuusala@danskebank.fi or +358 (0)50 336 6476. Jukka is best available on November 2nd at 13-15 (CET) and November 6th at 13-15 (CET).

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Bring your banking and data experience into our newly established Markets Data Office. Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, influence how we work and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will take ownership of data governance activities within one of our four domain areas. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams to improve how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices, while also helping to define and improve these as the team develops.

Your responsibilities will include

• Taking ownership of ongoing data governance activities within your domain and driving them forward

• Identifying and documenting Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data attributes with stakeholders, assessing which are critical for Saxo and driving the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and lead root cause investigations

• Defining and maintaining data definitions, rules, thresholds and documentation used in monitoring and control activities

• Monitoring data quality outputs, tracking remediation and escalating when issues are not being resolved

• Building strong working relationships with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Helping shape the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain, helping create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You bring:

• Some years of experience from the banking sector, which is a requirement for this position

• Experience in data analysis, data quality, data governance or a related field

• The ability to understand data in the context of business processes and explain your findings clearly to both business and technical audiences

• The ability to produce clear and structured documentation

• Hands on experience with SQL. Experience with Python is an advantage

• Experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

It would be a clear advantage if you have

• Experience from Markets functions such as trading, market or counterparty risk, investment products or operations, including an understanding of how a trade moves from front to back

• Experience with data governance in financial services, for example CDEs, data ownership, data profiling, data controls, data lineage or BCBS 239

• Experience with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar data platforms and data quality tools

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build trust with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You can manage changing priorities, bring structure to areas that are still developing and help shape solutions as the team grows.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function and its foundations from the ground up

• Real ownership and influence on how critical data is governed across Markets

• Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced colleagues across Markets, data and technology

• A role that can develop alongside a growing team

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges, grow your responsibility and influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Sr. Director, Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead world-class expertise at the front of differentiating peptide and protein drug discovery? Do you want to impact the drug discovery strategy that helps new candidates move faster, more reliably and with stronger scientific confidence towards first human dose?

If so, this is a unique opportunity to advance molecular expression, bioanalysis and ADME science, accelerate drug innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases, and champion technological innovation and collaboration across boundaries to deliver exceptional performance across discovery and development.

**The Position

**As Sr. Director for Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME, you will lead two centres of excellence and set the direction for the area that enables novel peptide and protein candidates to move quickly and reliably towards first human dose (FHD). Your leadership will enhance molecular expression, PK and ADME science, safeguard critical timelines and strengthen the competitiveness of the discovery portfolio.

You will provide senior leadership for the Centre for Expression Engineering and the Centre for Bioanalysis & ADME, shaping strategy and delivery across the area. You will partner closely with Research Centres of Excellence (RCE), Therapeutic Discovery, Chemistry Manufacturing and Control (CMC), Global Research, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS), CROs and academic and biotech collaborators to keep projects progressing with clarity, quality and speed.

You will lead a team of Department Managers and Scientific Directors and, together with them, guide a high-performing, purpose-driven team of around 80 colleagues in total. As a member of the RCE leadership team, you will help move decisions forward and shaping the culture, represent the area in steering committees and sponsor initiatives that improve business outcomes and collaboration.

Location: Måløv, Denmark.

**What You’ll Do

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Inspire and empower department managers and teams through visionary leadership and meaningful mentorship, nurturing talent and creating opportunities for people to grow, thrive and succeed together.

• Build a high-capability, high-performance, challenge-safe and collaborative culture through role-modelling, talent development, succession planning and continuous efficiency improvements.

• Identify and sponsor cross-organisational initiatives that improve business outcomes, collaboration and research impact.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role in pharmaceutical drug discovery. To succeed, you will bring:

• A PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech research, including drug discovery and preclinical development.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Strong collaborative leadership, enterprise and pragmatic mindset and the ability to build partnerships across disciplines and with external partners.

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to optimise discovery and development.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Given the strong scientific expertise already embedded across the organization, direct experience in all technical disciplines is not essential. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.

The work moves at pace, combining scientific ambition with a strong performance culture where your contribution is recognised.

You will be part of a collaborative high-performing leadership team where people keep things informal, find creative solutions together and have fun along the way.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the science that gets competitive new drug candidates to patients faster, apply for the Sr. Director, EEBA role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Market Data and Exchange Relations Manager
jobs.description:
Want to put your financial markets expertise to work across exchanges, market data providers and multiple asset classes? Join Saxo’s Market Data & Exchange Relations team and take ownership in an area connecting markets, technology and commercial relationships.

About the role

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, market data, exchanges and technology in an international environment. You will collaborate with exchanges, market data providers and colleagues across Saxo, helping ensure that the data supporting our trading platforms and internal systems is managed effectively.

The Market Data & Exchange Relations team manages licensing and relationships with the external vendors and exchanges that provide market data to Saxo's trading platforms and internal systems.

Depending on your experience, you may bring established market data expertise to the team or relevant experience from another part of the financial sector and an interest in developing further within market data and exchange relations.

You will gain broad exposure to the financial markets value chain and work across multiple asset classes, including equities, futures, options and bonds.

The position involves collaboration across Saxo's international organisation, including commercial, operational, technology, finance and other specialist teams. You will also engage directly with exchanges and external data providers.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include a combination of contract management, operational and commercial, including:

• Managing and maintaining relationships with market data vendors and exchanges, including licensing requirements and usage rights

• Negotiating, reviewing and maintaining market data licensing and vendor agreements, including commercial terms, permitted use and redistribution rights

• Acting as a point of contact for exchanges, vendors and other external partners

• Working with internal teams on billing, budgeting and reporting

• Monitoring and analysing market data usage, licensing permissions, entitlements and reporting obligations

• Supporting appropriate and compliant use of licensed market data across the organisation, in line with exchange and vendor licensing terms

• Providing market data licensing expertise and guidance to internal projects, new products and initiatives

• Managing day-to-day enquiries from internal and external stakeholders

• Supporting the ongoing development of processes and controls within the Market Data & Exchange Relations area

The scope and level of ownership can be adapted to your experience.

Your profile

We are interested in candidates with experience from market data, financial markets, exchanges, trading, financial services or a related field.

You may already be an experienced market data professional, or you may have developed relevant knowledge in another area of the financial sector and see market data as your next specialisation.

We expect that you:

• Have relevant professional experience within financial services, market data or a related environment

• Have an interest in financial markets and how data supports trading and investment services

• Are comfortable working with contracts, data, processes and multiple stakeholders

• Take a structured and reliable approach to your work and can manage competing priorities

• Communicate effectively with both specialist and non-specialist stakeholders

• Are comfortable working with Excel, datasets and presentation tools and can learn new systems

• Can work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment

• Are comfortable working in English in an international organisation

Experience working directly with market data vendors, stock exchanges, market data licensing, usage rights, redistribution, entitlements, reporting obligations or market data agreements would be valuable, but candidates with transferable experience from the wider financial sector are also encouraged to apply.

An international role with broad market exposure

This position provides an opportunity to develop a detailed understanding of how financial-market data moves from exchanges and providers into the systems and services used by investors and market participants.

You will work with colleagues and external partners across markets and functions, giving you exposure to both the commercial and operational aspects of market data.

Whether you bring several years of specialist experience or are looking to broaden your financial-markets expertise, the role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership while continuing to develop your knowledge.

The position is based at Saxo Bank's headquarters in Denmark.

Curious about how technology and AI can improve the way we work with data? Join Saxo and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and have a real influence on how we work.

What you will do

Technology will be an important part of your role. Together with colleagues in the team, you will help strengthen our technical foundation. This could mean building AI supported workflows, contributing to Azure projects, automating manual processes or exploring new tools and platforms.

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work across our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on the domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market and price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your own areas and tasks. You will be part of one Markets Data Office, working with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. You will sit close to the business and help turn business needs into practical technical solutions. We want you to experiment, test ideas and find better ways of working.

Your responsibilities will include

• Exploring and testing new technology, including AI, and helping the team choose and use the right tools

• Setting up reporting and dashboards for data owners and data stewards, for example in Power BI

• Automating manual parts of our governance work, including data quality checks, documentation and metadata

• Building and maintaining AI supported workflows and data workflows together with colleagues and technology teams, for example in Azure or Databricks

• Testing and validating automated workflows, including AI outputs, before they are used in day to day governance work

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Working with data owners, stewards and stakeholders across business and technology, and helping translate between business needs and technical solutions

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of the role is making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You have recently completed a master’s degree or have around one to two years of professional experience.

• A relevant degree in areas such as information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it supports business processes, combined with an interest in connecting business and technology

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or personal projects

• Hands on experience using AI or other technology to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you are curious, willing to learn and motivated to build your technical skills.

An advantage if you have

• Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Great Expectations, data catalogue tools such as OpenMetadata or similar technologies

• Experience building with AI beyond everyday use, for example agents, LiteLLM based workflows, prompt engineering or automation using tools such as Power Automate

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Monthly controlling of accounts including cost controlling, balance sheet controlling and intercompany (IC) controlling

• Prepare and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborate with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Act as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and 3-5 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You also have experience in consolidation and are motivated by building best practices, solving complex issues and developing the finance function.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Danish GAAP and consolidation principles knowledge

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

Join us in a shared student role where you will support both our e-commerce activities and international business development work.

You will work across two teams with data as the common thread. You will support recurring analyses and reporting, help create transparency from complex datasets, and contribute to material used for commercial decisions.

Your key tasks

• Collect, structure, validate, and analyse e-commerce, market, competitor, and other commercial data.

• Maintain recurring reports and performance overviews, and identify trends, gaps and potential business opportunities

• Turn complex data into clear insights, visualisations and presentations for commercial stakeholders and management

• Support e-commerce and business development projects by preparing analyses, consolidating input, and improving data-driven ways of working

What we are looking for

• You are studying at your last year at the bachelor's degree or at the master's level

• You are comfortable working with data and have solid Excel and Power BI skills. Experienced user of PowerPoint and AI tools is an advantage

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented way and can communicate findings clearly

• You are curious, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across teams and countries.

• You communicate confidently in English

What we offer

• A varied student role combining e-commerce and international business development tasks

• Hands-on experience with commercial analysis, management presentations and data-driven decision support

• Growing responsibility for recurring tasks, with guidance and sparring from experienced colleagues

• Flexible working hours that can be adapted to your studies. (Expect to be in office in Bjerringbro bi-weekly)

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Desk Quant (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop financial models, applications, and quantitative solutions that support our trading of financial instruments in Nykredit Markets? Are you motivated by combining financial insight, technology, and quantitative analysis in a high-performing environment with strong expertise, significant responsibility, and visible impact? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly – a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Desk Quant who wants to work close to the business and contribute to developing and maintaining solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Trading support: Work closely with our trading desks and contribute to daily market activities where Dragonfly and other quant solutions are used.

• Financial modeling and quantitative analysis: Configure, analyze, and apply our models for pricing and risk management of financial products.

• Development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for the business.

• Model setup and risk calculations: Contribute to the setup, maintenance, and further development of models and risk calculations in both Dragonfly and other trading systems.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Markets-focused use of AI: Help identify and implement AI-driven solutions where they create business value.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong analytical skills and are motivated by solving complex financial challenges,

• have a solid understanding of quantitative modeling and financial theory,

• have programming experience in Python and strong Excel skills,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong performance focus and multiple parallel tasks,

• have an interest in financial markets and products.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Pricing & Structuring team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision support to remain at the forefront of the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contact me, David Sloth Pedersen, Head of Quantitative Solutions, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Software Tester who can drive testing activities across complex digital solutions. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and following up on testing efforts while working closely with business stakeholders, developers, product owners, and other teams.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can switch context between multiple initiatives during the day, and enjoys taking ownership of quality assurance from requirements through delivery.

While the primary focus is manual testing, experience with test automation or a strong interest in helping establish and expand automation capabilities is considered an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities

**Manual Testing

• Create and maintain comprehensive test plans and test strategies.

• Execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end tests.

• Validate user interfaces, user experience, usability, and business workflows.

• Test across multiple browsers, devices, systems, and environments.

• Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure overall solution quality.

• Test applications, websites, APIs, databases, and system integrations.

• Understand and validate business requirements, business rules, technical requirements, workflows, and processes.

• Document findings, defects, risks, and recommendations clearly and effectively.

Test Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Drive testing activities across projects and releases.

• Coordinate testing efforts with developers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and external partners.

• Facilitate alignment on testing scope, priorities, risks, and release readiness.

• Ensure testing activities are tracked, communicated, and followed through to completion.

Automation (Preferred)

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts.

• Identify suitable test scenarios and processes for automation.

• Execute automated test suites and analyse results.

• Maintain stable, reusable, and scalable automated tests.

• Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.

• Contribute to building and improving the organization's automation capabilities.

Qualifications & ExperienceWe are looking for someone who has:

• Solid experience in manual software testing.

• Experience creating test plans and coordinating testing activities.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance processes.

• Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, and backend systems.

• Knowledge of, or practical experience working with, ISTQB or TMAP testing frameworks.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to independently drive testing activities and follow up on actions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch context when needed.

Nice to HaveThe following are considered advantages but are not required:

• Hands-on experience implementing or expanding test automation.

• Experience working within a microservices architecture.

• Familiarity with Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, and database querying.

• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices.

• Certified in ISTQB or TMAP.

You Might Have a Background As

• Software Tester / QA Engineer

• Manual Tester

• Technical Product Owner with testing experience

• Software Developer with a passion for quality assurance

• Test Automation Engineer looking for a role with strong business engagement

Are you currently studying business, supply chain, or a related field - and looking to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, international work environment? Our Contract Manufacturing Operations department is looking for a structured and detail-oriented Student Assistant to support our Supplier Relationship Teams

About the job

As a Student Assistant you will become an integral part of our CMO department, where you will support our four SRT teams in a cross-functional capacity. Each team manages a cluster of external suppliers, and your role will be essential in ensuring smooth coordination and continuous product supply through collaboration with both suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your key tasks include:

• Sharing forecast and purchase orders with our global suppliers

• Processing Purchase Orders and coordination

• Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding order status and updates

• Supporting various operational activities across the SRT teams

There is an opportunity to build and expand your areas of responsibility, as personal and professional development is highly valued within Orifarm.

We are looking for someone who can work approximately 15 hours a week. However, we offer flexibility around exam periods.

Who are you?

We imagine that you are currently enrolled in higher education within business, purchasing, supply chain or similar.

The ideal candidate is:

• Highly organized and detail-focused

• Analytically skilled

• Comfortable communicating with a wide range of stakeholders – both internally and externally

• Proficient in English (written and spoken); Danish is a plus

• Confident using Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Who are we?

Our CMO department consists of 23 employees divided into 4 teams with the main objective of ensuring continuous and reliable product supply from our external suppliers within the two business areas: prescription medicine (Specialty) and OTC & Food Supplements.

You will work independently on various tasks after thorough training. Support and guidance are always available when needed, and you will be part of an ambitious and dynamic department where everyone is treated equally.

You will join 70 other talented student assistants from diverse educational backgrounds as part of our Student Network Orifarm (SNO). SNO organizes social and professional events, allowing you to expand your network and connect with other students across functions.

Why should you work for Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, giving you a valuable start to your career. As our student assistant, you may have the opportunity to complete an internship or collaborate with us on your bachelor’s or master’s thesis. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable healthcare accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Use AI to change how Orifarm’s commercial teams analyze, report and decide. We are looking for a senior insights professional who builds it, proves it and brings colleagues along

About the job

In this role, you will drive the change in how we work with data and insight; first in our own reporting and analysis, then across the commercial organization, together with colleagues in the markets, Finance and IT. We are looking for someone with natural curiosity who knows how to use modern technology to turn data into business insights, in a streamlined way, across the commercial organization.

You will:

• Lead the commercial transformation of our reporting and analysis (monthly market and commercial reporting, portfolio reviews, ad hoc requests) with AI: not just faster, but fundamentally better and less manual

• Build practical AI workflows and assistants, using approved tools such as Claude and Copilot, that work across multiple, large datasets, e.g. internal sales, profitability, market, CRM and pricing data, in close collaboration with the AI Office

• Accelerate the use of AI across the commercial organization, turning enterprise AI capabilities and principles into business value

• Define the commercial data and insight requirements needed to make AI use cases successful, working with the AI Office, IT, Finance and data owners on the appropriate data foundation

• Apply Orifarm’s AI governance and quality guardrails to commercial use cases, including validation and appropriate human review of AI-supported management output

You will report to the Director of Commercial Excellence & Insights and become part of the Market Insights & Support team, working closely with the commercial leadership and our AI office. This is a senior individual contributor role, based in Odense or Copenhagen, with a hybrid work model.

Who are you?

You are a commercially minded professional with 5+ years of experience in business analysis, commercial insights, reporting or business transformation. You understand how to turn complex data into clear recommendations that support decisions and improve commercial performance. Experience from the pharmaceutical industry is not required, as we can teach you the industry.

You are confident working with multiple, large datasets and tools such as Excel and Power BI, and you know AI’s limits well enough to validate its output. You use generative AI as a practical business tool to strengthen analysis, simplify workflows and improve the quality of insights, and you can show examples of where it has changed real work. You work within Orifarm’s approved tools and data-security guidelines and collaborate closely with Finance, IT and other specialists

Equally important, you are a strong communicator and change facilitator. You explain complex topics simply, build trust quickly and help colleagues, including senior stakeholders, adopt new ways of working. You are pragmatic, curious and quality-minded, with sound commercial judgement. You know when human review is essential, and you are not afraid to say “not yet” when the output is not good enough.

You are fluent in English. Danish is not required.

Who are we?

You will join a small, close team that supports the commercial organization with insight, data and systems, and sits right next to the commercial leadership team, so your work is seen and used. We are six colleagues including you, working closely together in a direct, hands-on and informal way. Orifarm has a flat structure and short paths to decision-makers.

Why should you join Orifarm?

Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable medicine accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future.
